subject: Engagement platform shortlist & procurement timeline
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick: shortlist vendors + procurement schedule for Sales engagement tooling

Team —

Per Q4 ops rhythm we need to finalize a recommendation for the Sales engagement stack (Outreach/Salesloft vs HubSpot sequences + native sales tools) before the 11/12 exec procurement review. Can each of you do the following by EOD Tuesday?

- Monica: confirm current usage metrics (monthly seats, avg daily sends, cadence types) and any redlines from CS.
- Rishi: confirm integrations required (SFDC fields, cadence sync, activity logging) and migration complexity notes.
- Laura: capture procurement window constraints (PO timing, preferred contract length, renewal alignment with fiscal) and any preferred vendor terms.

I started a comparison sheet (Drive link below). I want a one-slide recommendation for the review: keep Outreach (renew + negotiate seats), move to HubSpot sequences, or hybrid. Priorities: deliverability, visibility in SFDC, unit cost per contact, and ease of ramp.

Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cSalesOpsShortlist

Thanks — Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T13:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick: shortlist vendors + procurement schedule for Sales engagement tooling

Marcus —

Attached the usage snapshot and a short notes tab in the sheet. Key items:
- Active paid seats: 42 (AE/SDR mix)
- Avg daily outbound send volume: ~18k/week (spikes during campaign)
- Current outbound cadence types: sequence, task reminders, multi-channel (email + LinkedIn) via Outreach.
- Redlines from CS: no third-party access to PII, need SOC2 evidence, audit logs for message sending.

Attachment referenced: SalesOps-comparison-sheet.xlsx (see tab "Usage")

I'm leaning toward keeping Outreach for outbound-heavy plays (deliverability + proven cadence tooling) but recommending a negotiation on per-seat costs and improved SLAs. Happy to summarize into a slide.

-Monica

--
Monica Patel
Senior Sales Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick: shortlist vendors + procurement schedule for Sales engagement tooling

Marcus / Monica —

Integration notes (summary):
- SFDC: Outreach currently writes activity to Task/Activity with custom mapping; HubSpot sequences can write to Engagements but we'd need field mapping and workflow updates.
- GDPR/logging: both vendors can surface activity logs; Outreach has a longer history of per-email send logs we can export.
- Migration risks: migrating existing sequences to HubSpot will require reauthoring ~120 active sequences; expect a 3-4 week effort with two engineers + a Sales Ops lead.

If legal requires vendor-hosted data restrictions, HubSpot contract has more standard enterprise options, Outreach will require a negotiated addendum.

-Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Jamie Ortiz <jamie@outreachcorp.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Outreach proposal + quick clarifications

Hi Marcus / Monica / Rishi —

Thanks for the time earlier. Attached is a refresh of our November pricing and an enterprise addendum with SOC2 language and data residency options. Highlights:
- 30% sticker reduction for a 12-month committed seat term at 50+ seats (we quoted on 42, we can tier).
- Dedicated onboarding credit for sequence migration (up to 40 hours) and a 2-week dedicated enablement slot.
- Audit logs export available on request (CSV delivery) and expanded retention for enterprise accounts.

Attachments: Outreach-pricing-2026.pdf

Two quick questions for procurement: what's your preferred PO cadence? And do you need a contract with a data processing addendum (DPA) signed before PO?

Happy to hop on a 20 min call to walk the offer.

Best,
Jamie Ortiz
Enterprise Accounts — Outreach Corp.
jamie@outreachcorp.com

From: Priya Shah <priya@hubspot.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-04T09:35:00-08:00
Subject: HubSpot sequences offer for Acme evaluation

Hi Marcus / Laura —

Following up on the HubSpot side — I've included a tailored offer and an implementation outline. Quick notes:
- HubSpot can consolidate CRM + sequences which reduces duplicate syncs and lowers complexity.
- Offer includes migration support to import sequences (we estimate a 2-3 week timeline) and a playbook for activity mapping to your Salesforce instance.
- Pricing: we can create a pilot package for 45 seats for Q1 with a convert-to-annual credit.

Attached: HubSpot-offer-Nov2026.pdf

If procurement prefers one vendor to own the end-to-end contract, HubSpot can act as the single contract holder and manage integration partners.

Best regards,
Priya Shah
Enterprise Sales — HubSpot

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Arjun Menon - Procurement (acme-inc) <arjun.m@acme-inc.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jamie Ortiz <jamie@outreachcorp.com>, Priya Shah <priya@hubspot.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T11:50:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Engagement platform shortlist & procurement timeline

Arjun —

Thanks for confirming the procurement windows. To be explicit for the 11/12 exec review (internal at Acme):
- We will present a recommended vendor and a fallback (if negotiation stalls).
- Preferred contract start: 2027-01-01 to align to fiscal.
- PO required by 12/20 to hit implementation for Q1 ramp.

Vendors: Jamie (Outreach) and Priya (HubSpot) are both on this thread and have shared offers. We've attached the comparison sheet and marked the recommended path (see "Recommendation" tab).

Action items for Acme procurement team: please confirm whether you require a signed DPA before issuing PO and whether Acme prefers vendor-as-contractor vs Redwood-managed contract.

Happy to set a 15 min sync post-review.

Thanks — Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Arjun Menon <arjun.m@acme-inc.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jamie Ortiz <jamie@outreachcorp.com>, Priya Shah <priya@hubspot.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T14:33:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Engagement platform shortlist & procurement timeline

Marcus / team —

Appreciate the clear timeline. Short answers:
- We generally require a DPA signed prior to PO for vendor-hosted messaging tools. Please attach your standard DPA or confirm vendor will provide.
- Acme prefers vendor-as-contractor where possible. If Redwood acts as reseller, please note we will require vendor indemnities mirrored in the Redwood contract.
- PO by 12/20 is acceptable; we will escalate if legal needs more time.

We will proceed with the exec review on 11/12 and loop back with next steps.

-Arjun
Procurement Manager, Acme Inc.
